application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Application to clear condition 4 (Cycle store), 5 (Energy) and 7 (SUDS) of approved application DM2025/00797.
decision_conditions: Prior to the commencement of the development (excluding demolition works), full details of the secure cycle storage facilities shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority which shall show their positioning within the site, the size and materials of the enclosure and the means of access. The approved details shall be implemented on site prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the development provides an adequate level of cycle parking facilities and to encourage sustainable modes of transport, in accordance with Policies 36 and 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018. This condition is required to be pre-commencement as cycle storage needs to be designed into the scheme at a early stage of the construction process and respect the materials and design of the development.
Any vehicle parked on the garage forecourt should not be allowed to overhang the highway boundary as to do so without lawful authority may be an offence against section 137 of the Highway Act 1980.

Prior to the commencement of development, a SuDS strategy for the management of surface water run-off must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which:(i) includes the results of on-site infiltration testing to BRE Digest 365;(ii) identifies appropriate SuDS measures, in order to manage surface water runoff as close to its source as possible in line with the Mayor's drainage hierarchy(iii) includes calculations carried out by an appropriately qualified professional to show that the peak run-off rate for the 1 in 100 year 6-hour rainfall event (plus 40% for climate change) will be as close as reasonably practicable to the greenfield run-off rate for the same event; and(iv) demonstrates that the 1 in 30 year rainfall event (plus 40% for climate change) can be contained without flooding; any flooding occurring between the 1 in 30 and 1 in 100 year event (plus 40% for climate change) will be safely containedon site; and that rainfall in excess of the 1 in 100 year event is managed to minimise risksReason: To comply with London Plan Policy SI13 and Policy 32 of the Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the commencement of development, a revised Energy Statement for Planning incorporating updated 'as-designed' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing which demonstrates how the new dwelling will apply the Mayor's energy hierarchy (use less energy, supply energy efficiently and use renewable energy) to deliver or exceed the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions over and above the minimum 35% reduction compared to the Part L 2021 baseline. The revised Energy Statement for Planning must give consideration to on-site renewable energy generation technologies and demonstrate that at least a 10% reduction in overall emissions will delivered through on-site renewable technologies alone.Reason: To comply with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
